request.text: Battered road coupe at steady low revs. Constant body, seamlessly repeating; no ignition, acceleration, fade or backfire. Timbre: heavy uneven diesel piston knocks and vibrating steel casing. Close foundry steel, blunt low-mid weight, analog grit, short concrete reflection. 2 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.

edit.operation: mono resample, DC removal, 125 ms complementary overlap, measured interior rotation
edit.rotationPolicy: 48 interior candidates, minimum derivative/RMS/spectrum mismatch; no samples replaced
edit.blurRisk: Crossfade can blur motor pulses; repeated human listening pending

normalization.operation: measured gain with -2 dBTP ceiling; tanh soft limiting if crest exceeds ceiling
